summary: Points out gaps in the official Host-Host protocol found while building the network software. Cases such as error control messages, unusual message types, and messages flagged as coming from the IMP were not clearly described. The note suggests how implementations should handle these edge cases.

eli5.summary: A game's rulebook did not say what to do when something unexpected happens. A player writes down which odd situations came up and how to handle them.

questions: what gaps were found in the host-host protocol
how should an ncp handle unexpected messages
